procedure: Inspect and implement the segment-deposit table adapter using only the 2023 report.
Save a SHA-256 fingerprint of the adapter before running it on the 2022 report.
Run the frozen adapter on the 2022 report once and record success or failure.
Independently inspect the test report source table to validate values, units, columns and totals.
Do not tune the adapter on test failures. Any later tuning turns this report into development data.
limitations: One report-transfer test is a small format generalization check, not a statistical accuracy benchmark.
Comparative annual reports overlap in financial periods and may share layout. The split is by report, not independent financial facts.
No real LLM answer accuracy is measured by deterministic table tests.
